watcher.concluded: The CLOB price endpoint returned 404 with body 'No orderbook exists for the requested token id', which means the bot asked for a price on a token that has no live orderbook, typically a resolved or closed market. This is a single hit at INFO-worthy severity that the client logs as ERROR, and it is a normal transient condition when a market winds down.
